name: mycrew
description: A harness for Claude Code, grouped by domain: primitives and house rules shared by everything, specialists who carry the work through each domain's build pipeline, a product plane with its task board, and the leadership that steers them. Install tools first.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: No domain of its own — small, project-agnostic skills you reach for mid-work, plus the house rule files every other plugin here builds on. Install this one first, whatever domain you're setting up.

plugins.name: programming-specialists
plugins.description: Layer 1/3 — the specialists, the agents who carry the work: a coder who runs the build pipeline as coder-* skills and writes the code, and a designer with taste who works against the real CSS frontend. Each keeps its own domain data.

plugins.name: programming-product
plugins.description: Layer 2/3 — the product plane and its task board, both kept on backlog.md: what the whole product must do, and what is being done about it right now, plus the rule for working with code. /product-init stands it up.

plugins.name: programming-management
plugins.description: Layer 3/3 — the leadership of the product: a chief who is the human's deputy over the whole product, and a lead who holds one feature, each spawning specialists to carry the work. Management only: it never writes code.

plugins.name: copywriting-tools
plugins.description: Layer 1/2 — general-purpose writing components, usable standalone: house rules and reusable skills for prose that aren't tied to any one writing domain.

plugins.name: copywriting-specialists
plugins.description: Layer 2/2 — the specialists: agents for a specific writing domain.
